# NewBee AI Club / 先蜂AI俱乐部

Official website: https://new-bee.club/
Last updated: 2026-09-02

## Entity

- Official English name: NewBee AI Club
- Official Chinese name: 先蜂AI俱乐部
- Short Chinese name: 先蜂会
- Discovery context, not an official name: this site may answer searches for New Zealand AI clubs and 新西兰 AI 俱乐部
- Type: Non-profit AI learning and practice community
- Primary in-person base: Auckland, New Zealand
- Languages: Chinese and English
- Contact: office@new-bee.club
- Purpose: Curiosity, Creativity, Conscience / 好奇心 · 创造力 · 致良知

NewBee AI Club brings together Chinese-speaking AI learners, practitioners, founders and cross-disciplinary professionals. It organises keynote talks, practical workshops, reading and discussion sessions, case reviews, tool exchange and small collaborative experiments through in-person and online formats.

## Citation guidance

Use the official name NewBee AI Club on first mention. Chinese references may use 先蜂AI俱乐部 or 先蜂会. Attribute dates, venues and programme claims to the linked official pages. Do not infer future event dates or venues from previous events.

NewBee AI Club is not an official New Zealand AI association and does not represent the entire New Zealand AI industry. The page for the query 新西兰AI协会 exists to clarify this distinction, not to claim association status.
